mapper.sql: id::text, inst_id::text AS organization_id, nm AS name, adptr_cd AS adapter_code, lnkg_addr AS endpoint, secrt_rfrnc_nm AS secret_reference, use_yn AS enabled, lmt_sec_cnt AS timeout_seconds, max_prcstry_nmtm AS max_attempts, max_qpage_cnt AS max_pages, lck_ver_no AS lock_version, mdfcn_dt AS updated_at

id::text, sou_lnkg_id::text AS connection_id, rqstr_id::text AS requested_by, type_cd AS kind, stts_cd AS status, dmnd_hash_vl AS request_hash, stng_ver_no AS configuration_version, mpng_ver_nm AS mapping_version, prcstry_nmtm AS attempt, joblse_tkn_id::text AS lease_token, bfr_chkpt_vl AS checkpoint_before, aftr_chkpt_vl AS checkpoint_after, err_cd AS error_code, crt_dt AS created_at, bgng_dt AS started_at, end_dt AS finished_at, phase_cd AS phase, tot_artcl_cnt AS total_count, prgrs_dt AS progress_at, CASE WHEN stts_cd='RETRY_WAIT' THEN excn_psblty_dt ELSE NULL END AS next_attempt_at, prcs_artcl_cnt AS processed_count,save_artcl_cnt AS saved_count,unchg_artcl_cnt AS unchanged_count,fail_artcl_cnt AS failed_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM integration.source_connection WHERE id=#{id}::uuid FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM integration.source_connection WHERE inst_id=#{org}::uuid ORDER BY crt_dt DESC,id LIMIT 200
SELECT count(*) FROM integration.sync_run WHERE sou_lnkg_id=#{id}::uuid AND stts_cd IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM integration.source_connection c JOIN identity.organization o ON o.id=c.inst_id WHERE c.id=#{id}::uuid AND c.lck_ver_no=#{version} AND c.use_yn AND o.stts_cd='ACTIVE')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity.organization WHERE id=#{id}::uuid AND stts_cd='ACTIVE')

SELECT id::text,prcs_user_id::text AS actor_id,prcs_cd AS action,dmnd_id AS request_id,stng_ver_no AS configuration_version,ocrn_dt AS occurred_at FROM integration.connection_event WHERE lnkg_id=#{id}::uuid ORDER BY ocrn_dt DESC,id LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration.sync_run(id,sou_lnkg_id,rqstr_id,type_cd,idmpt_key_hash_vl,dmnd_hash_vl,stng_ver_no,mpng_ver_nm,bfr_chkpt_vl) VALUES (#{id}::uuid,#{connection}::uuid,#{actor}::uuid,#{kind},#{digest},#{hash},#{version},#{mapping},#{checkpoint}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM integration.sync_run WHERE sou_lnkg_id=#{connection}::uuid AND rqstr_id=#{actor}::uuid AND type_cd=#{kind} AND idmpt_key_hash_vl=#{digest}
SELECT FROM integration.sync_run WHERE sou_lnkg_id=#{id}::uuid ORDER BY crt_dt DESC,id LIMIT 100

WITH cand_cn AS ( SELECT id FROM integration.sync_run WHERE ((stts_cd IN ('QUEUED','RETRY_WAIT') AND excn_psblty_dt <= clock_timestamp()) OR (stts_cd='RUNNING' AND joblse_expry_dt < clock_timestamp())) ORDER BY excn_psblty_dt,crt_dt,id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ), claimed AS ( UPDATE integration.sync_run r SET stts_cd='RUNNING',joblse_tkn_id=#{token}::uuid, phase_cd=CASE WHEN r.type_cd='CHECK' THEN 'CHECKING_CONNECTION' ELSE 'FETCHING_LIST' END,prgrs_dt=clock_timestamp(), joblse_expry_dt=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',prcstry_nmtm=prcstry_nmtm+1,bgng_dt=COALESCE(bgng_dt,clock_timestamp()) FROM cand_cn c WHERE r.id=c.id RETURNING r.* ) SELECT FROM claimed
mapper.update: UPDATE integration.sync_run SET joblse_expry_dt=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds' WHERE id=#{id}::uuid AND stts_cd='RUNNING' AND joblse_tkn_id=#{token}::uuid AND joblse_expry_dt > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE integration.sync_run SET stts_cd=#{status},err_cd=#{error},end_dt=clock_timestamp(),joblse_tkn_id=NULL,joblse_expry_dt=NULL, phase_cd=CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED') THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,prgrs_dt=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id}::uuid AND stts_cd='RUNNING' AND joblse_tkn_id=#{token}::uuid AND joblse_expry_dt > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE integration.sync_run SET stts_cd='RETRY_WAIT',err_cd=#{error},excn_psblty_dt=clock_timestamp()+(#{delay} * interval '1 second'),joblse_tkn_id=NULL,joblse_expry_dt=NULL, phase_cd='RETRY_WAIT',prgrs_dt=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id}::uuid AND stts_cd='RUNNING' AND joblse_tkn_id=#{token}::uuid AND joblse_expry_dt > clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT cursr_vl AS cursor FROM integration.sync_checkpoint WHERE sou_lnkg_id=#{id}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration.sync_checkpoint(sou_lnkg_id,cursr_vl,last_scs_excn_id) VALUES (#{connection}::uuid,#{cursor},#{id}::uuid) ON CONFLICT(sou_lnkg_id) DO UPDATE SET cursr_vl=EXCLUDED.cursr_vl,last_scs_excn_id=EXCLUDED.last_scs_excn_id,lck_ver_no=integration.sync_checkpoint.lck_ver_no+1
mapper.update: UPDATE integration.sync_run SET aftr_chkpt_vl=#{cursor} WHERE id=#{id}::uuid AND stts_cd='RUNNING' AND joblse_tkn_id=#{token}::uuid AND joblse_expry_dt > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE integration.sync_run SET phase_cd=#{phase},tot_artcl_cnt=COALESCE(#{total,jdbcType=INTEGER},tot_artcl_cnt),prgrs_dt=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id}::uuid AND stts_cd='RUNNING' AND joblse_tkn_id=#{token}::uuid AND joblse_expry_dt > clock_timestamp()

UPDATE integration.sync_run r SET prcs_artcl_cnt=s.processed,save_artcl_cnt=s.saved, unchg_artcl_cnt=s.unchanged,fail_artcl_cnt=s.failed,prgrs_dt=clock_timestamp() FROM (SELECT count(*)::integer AS processed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stts_cd='CANDIDATE')::integer AS saved, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stts_cd='UNCHANGED')::integer AS unchanged, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stts_cd='FAILED')::integer AS failed FROM integration.sync_item WHERE sync_excn_id=#{id}::uuid) s WHERE r.id=#{id}::uuid AND r.stts_cd='RUNNING' AND r.joblse_tkn_id=#{token}::uuid AND r.joblse_expry_dt > clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT sou_hash_vl AS source_hash FROM integration.source_metadata WHERE sou_lnkg_id=#{connection}::uuid AND otsd_id=#{external}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration.source_metadata(id,sou_lnkg_id,otsd_id,sou_hash_vl,sou_rvsn_nm,cand_cn,mpng_ver_nm,last_excn_id) VALUES (#{candidateId}::uuid,#{connection}::uuid,#{external},#{hash},#{revision},#{candidate}::jsonb,#{mapping},#{id}::uuid) ON CONFLICT(sou_lnkg_id,otsd_id) DO UPDATE SET sou_hash_vl=EXCLUDED.sou_hash_vl,sou_rvsn_nm=EXCLUDED.sou_rvsn_nm, cand_cn=EXCLUDED.cand_cn,mpng_ver_nm=EXCLUDED.mpng_ver_nm,last_excn_id=EXCLUDED.last_excn_id, rvsn_no=integration.source_metadata.rvsn_no+1,mdfcn_dt=clock_timestamp() WHERE integration.source_metadata.sou_hash_vl <> EXCLUDED.sou_hash_vl
mapper.update: UPDATE integration.source_metadata SET sou_rvsn_nm=#{revision},last_excn_id=#{id}::uuid, cand_cn=CASE WHEN #{modifiedAt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::text IS NULL THEN cand_cn #- '{details,sourceModifiedAt}' ELSE jsonb_set(cand_cn,'{details,sourceModifiedAt}',to_jsonb(#{modifiedAt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::text),true) END WHERE sou_lnkg_id=#{connection}::uuid AND otsd_id=#{external} AND sou_hash_vl=#{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration.sync_item(id,sync_excn_id,otsd_id,sou_hash_vl,stts_cd,err_cd,prcstry_nmtm) VALUES (#{itemId}::uuid,#{id}::uuid,#{external},#{hash},#{status},#{error},#{attempt}) ON CONFLICT(sync_excn_id,otsd_id) DO UPDATE SET sou_hash_vl=EXCLUDED.sou_hash_vl, stts_cd=CASE WHEN sync_item.stts_cd='CANDIDATE' AND EXCLUDED.stts_cd='UNCHANGED' AND sync_item.sou_hash_vl=EXCLUDED.sou_hash_vl THEN 'CANDIDATE' ELSE EXCLUDED.stts_cd END,err_cd=EXCLUDED.err_cd, prcstry_nmtm=EXCLUDED.prcstry_nmtm,mdfcn_dt=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT otsd_id AS external_id,stts_cd AS status,sou_hash_vl AS source_hash,err_cd AS error_code,prcstry_nmtm AS attempt,mdfcn_dt AS updated_at FROM integration.sync_item WHERE sync_excn_id=#{id}::uuid ORDER BY otsd_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM integration.sync_item WHERE sync_excn_id=#{id}::uuid
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM integration.sync_item WHERE sync_excn_id=#{id}::uuid AND stts_cd='FAILED')
